triggers.definition:
CREATE TRIGGER "trg_account_references_clear" AFTER DELETE ON "account" FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  -- The references to the row of Account deleted (D154, D182), cleared,
  -- and the row that held each told on its cleared queue.
  INSERT INTO "reference_cleared_queue" ("holder_table", "holder_key", "target_table", "target_key", "role")
    SELECT 'Message', CAST("message_id" AS TEXT), "target_table", "target_key", "role" FROM "message_references" WHERE "target_table" = 'Account' AND "target_key" = CAST(OLD."id" AS TEXT);
  DELETE FROM "message_references" WHERE "target_table" = 'Account' AND "target_key" = CAST(OLD."id" AS TEXT);
END
triggers.name: trg_account_references_clear

CREATE TRIGGER "trg_message_attachments_release" AFTER DELETE ON "message_attachments" FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  -- The object the file of MessageAttachments deleted named (D154, D182), released
  -- once no file of the table names it: its worker deletes it once no
  -- file of any table does.
  INSERT INTO "attachment_released_queue" ("object_key", "content_hash", "reason")
    SELECT OLD."object_key", OLD."content_hash", 'detached' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "message_attachments" WHERE "object_key" = OLD."object_key");
END
triggers.name: trg_message_attachments_release
